preregistration.readings: part (B) Readings and Pre-written sentences; part (A) rule (Contrast, sentences, Never)
verbatim: - Readings (primary40; all48 and clean36 sensitivities): (1) M1q-s2 pooled resolved / 120 and per seed; pooled ≥ 4 = notable (as v062); (2) termination metrics and think rate vs M0qmc as in v062 (descriptive); (3) M1q-s2 − A0mc with the rule of (A).

- Pre-written sentences: M1q-s2 ≥ 4/120 → "observed in two training seeds (10/120 and x/120) on the known holdout"; 1–3/120 → "below the notable threshold in the second seed (x/120)"; 0/120 → "seed-dependent: one of two training seeds (10/120 and 0/120)". Both seeds are always reported side by side; never pooled into one "M1q" number; the independent-repository requirement of v062 is not lifted by (B).

- Contrast: M1qmc − A0mc, primary40, paired by task with the three decoding seeds grouped (task-level bootstrap, 20,000 resamples as the v058 machinery draws), on pooled resolved; all48 and clean36 as sensitivities. Computed without rerunning either evaluation by tools/analyze_m1q_vs_a0mc_v067.py = the v062 analyzer re-pinned with slot M0 = the sealed v066 A0mc rows and slot M1 = the sealed v062 M1qmc rows; its sha is recorded in the v067 analysis contract before the A0mc report is read (ANALYZE v066 waits for it).
- Pre-written sentences (exactly one applies; chosen by the CI, never after inspection):
- lower bound > 0: "the masked arm on the QAT base resolved more tasks than the same-template base (x/120 vs y/120; +d pp [l, u]) — one training seed, known holdout";
- upper bound < 0: "the masked arm resolved fewer tasks than the same-template base (x/120 vs y/120; d pp [l, u])";
- otherwise: "relative to the same-template base the difference is uncertain (x/120 vs y/120; d pp [l, u])".
- Never: "recovery", "partial recovery", "closed the gap", "masking restores / causes repair", "no-collapse".

sentence_B.sentence: observed in two training seeds (10/120 and 6/120) on the known holdout

sentence.sentence: relative to the same-template base the difference is uncertain (6/120 vs 12/120; -5.00 pp [-11.67, +0.00])

definitions.think_rate: v032 producer M1: share of agent steps with a non-blank thinking event, i.e. non-empty returned reasoning
definitions.compaction_calls: audit.trace_items LLM calls; call k (1-based, k >= 2) is a compaction call when call k-1 prompt_tokens >= audit.THRESHOLD (14,336), the audit rule at audit.py:165-166; event availability is not re-evaluated
definitions.content_without_reasoning_calls: trace-observable proxy for responses without <channel|>: calls that directly follow a tool response of a previous call without visible text (the matched template prefills the opener there) and carry visible text but no non-blank thought; an empty thought followed by text looks the same, and a missing <channel|> with a bare tool call leaves no trace (reasoning None and "" both drop), so this count is an upper bound for the visible kind only
definitions.secondary: find_opener and repro_script_opener shares (M4), max repeat (M2.max_repeat), M5 silent and normal repeat rates: v042 paired effects on primary40, descriptive only
definitions.descriptive_rows: v051 M0mc, sealed v043 M0 and M1 (bf16 base), A0-capped v052, M1q (v062, seed 1) and A0mc (v066) primary40 three-seed means read from their pinned reports; no re-analysis, no contrast and no 2x2
definitions.scope: Reported for both slots, all48, per run and per task; descriptive, no threshold

method.scope: Conditional on this fixed familiar task population and one paired training seed; decoding seeds are not training replicates.
method.unit: paired whole-task cluster; retain the fixed three-seed vector for each sampled task in both arms

limitations: Known-holdout exploratory intervention prompted by prior observations; not independent heldout confirmation.
One paired training seed; three decoding seeds do not establish training-seed generality.
Semantic deduplication against training data is unverified.
Empty-thought/scaffold masking has prior art including ThinkPack; no method novelty claim.
No claim that history dropping is harmless or that effects are specific to small models.
Observed thought text is not direct evidence of internal reasoning; secondary mechanisms do not establish causal mediation.
Historical A0/A1 comparisons remain descriptive; historical A1 initialization is not reconstructed.

Prereg v067 limits apply: the second training seed of the M1q recipe (LoRA init seed 20261104), reported beside M1q (v062, seed 1) and never pooled with it; one data source, known holdout; the independent-repository requirement of v062 is not lifted; reading 2 is descriptive (no PK or think label); reading 3 applies the part (A) rule to M1q-s2 - A0mc; no mechanism and no causal attribution to masking; the descriptive rows are not contrasts and form no 2x2.
